author: sungeunk
title: PyTorch Layer Tests fail - builtin cannot be used as a value in reflection_pad TorchScript
signature: builtin cannot be used as a value|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: Pytorch Layer Tests / PyTorch Layer Tests

key_errors: FAILED ../../../home/runner/_work/openvino/openvino/install/tests/layer_tests/pytorch_tests/test_reflection_pad.py::TestReflectionPad::test_reflection_pad[ ie_device:CPU - precision:FP32 - pad:(3, 1, 5, 2) - n:2 ] - RuntimeError: Retrying hit TorchScript method redefinition and can mask the original failure. First error: Couldn't get TorchScript module by scripting.
builtin cannot be used as a value: File "test_reflection_pad.py", line 26, def forward_2d(self, x): return torch.ops.aten.reflection_pad2d(x, self.pad)
Last error: Couldn't get TorchScript module by scripting. Exception: Can't redefine method: forward on class: __torch__.test_reflection_pad.___torch_mangle_6685.aten_reflection_pad
root_cause: The pytorch_tests/test_reflection_pad.py test calls torch.ops.aten.reflection_pad2d directly inside a forward method intended to be TorchScript-scripted. TorchScript treats torch.ops.aten.* overload dispatch as a builtin that cannot be referenced as a first-class value, so scripting fails deterministically; the subsequent retry-with-tracing path then hits a 'method redefinition' error because the module was already partially compiled. This is a pre-existing defect in the PyTorch layer test harness/test file, unrelated to the PR under test (#39577, GPU MoE token-axis fix only touches src/plugins/intel_gpu). The same signature was first observed on 2026-09-01 in PR #37790 (a dependabot bump) and recurs here, confirming it is a long-standing, PR-independent test issue rather than a regression introduced by this change.
reproduction_steps: cd install/tests/layer_tests && python -m pytest pytorch_tests/test_reflection_pad.py::TestReflectionPad::test_reflection_pad -k 'pad:(3, 1, 5, 2) and n:2' --ie_device=CPU --precision=FP32
recommended_actions: Fix src/bindings/python layer test file test_reflection_pad.py (around line 26): avoid calling torch.ops.aten.reflection_pad2d directly inside a method intended for TorchScript scripting; either wrap it so scripting is skipped for this case or always force the tracing path by providing a valid example_input
Mark the failing test_reflection_pad[pad:(3, 1, 5, 2) - n:2] parametrization as xfail/skip until the scripting path is fixed, to stop blocking unrelated merge-queue runs

Confirm whether a recent PyTorch version bump changed TorchScript's handling of torch.ops.aten.* builtins (same signature recurred ~2 months after the first occurrence, so check CI history around PyTorch upgrades)
prevention_strategies: When writing PyTorch layer tests that rely on TorchScript scripting, avoid referencing torch.ops.aten.* overloads as callables inside scripted forward methods; prefer tracing with an explicit example_input, or guard scripting attempts with a documented skip/xfail so a known-incompatible test does not fail every merge-queue run regardless of the PR's actual changes.
historical_context: Identical signature (98cbf832e7e217cf) first recorded 2026-09-01 on PR #37790 (dependabot bump, run 33502706581) with the same root cause (torch.ops.aten.reflection_pad2d not scriptable). This is the 2nd occurrence; the underlying test defect was never fixed between then and now.
